name: 55421 · Columbia Hts, MN
findings: ZIP 55421 (Columbia Hts) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55421 (Columbia Hts) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
